bio: This elegant edifice, built out of wood, glass and steel, is home to a brasserie, a cocktail bar with a terrace, lounges and meeting rooms. The equally varied menu ranges from shrimp fritters and sole meunière to veal kidneys and ossobuco in a lineup of Franco-Belgian inspiration, dotted with a few Italian classics, all of which is underscored by a love of cooking and generous helpings. There is something for everyone at Mamy Louise....
